metadata.title: Non-Markovianity-assisted optimal continuous variable quantum teleportation

extraction_notes.note: Eq. (8) in the appendix repeats the master equation Eq. (1) verbatim up to line breaks; kept Eq. (1) as EP1 and put Eq. (8) in also_stated_at, likewise the surrounding sentence on DP1.
Equation numbering/labels are sloppy: \label{WBarMat} sits on an unnumbered row, and the text after Eq. (30) cites Eq. (A0R) for W-bar; edges were drawn by content where the \ref is wrong.

The main-text fidelity formula (Eqs. 2-3) is retained as a claim proved by the one-sentence appendix derivation 'Replacing Eq. (25) in Eq. (26) we finally obtain Eq. (2) and Eq. (3)'; the rest of Appendix 1.2 feeds it through the cited claims.
Figure-based discussion (fidelity vs. transit time curves), the 'Some considerations' paragraph on temperature scales, and the summary paragraph were left out as commentary on numerics.
